findings.issue: The Base Sepolia host rule is still a wildcard and has no opt-in, so it contradicts A08 and A23 (the earlier high finding is only partly fixed). A07 accepts "A08's *.base.org hosts" for chain id 84532 and never requires TESTNET_OPT_IN. A08 (line 49) matches exact hosts only, never wildcards: sepolia.base.org plus the hosts named in TOOLCHAIN.md, and only with TESTNET_OPT_IN=A86. A23 (lines 96, 146 and 151) asserts exact hosts, plants mainnet.base.org with CHAIN_ID=84532 plus the opt-in, and escalates if either list takes a wildcard. So A07's guard as written accepts mainnet.base.org for 84532 and fails A23. The source of truth is also circular: A08 says the extra hosts come from A07's TOOLCHAIN.md, and A07 says TOOLCHAIN.md is a copy of A08's list. Neither node depends on the other, so neither can copy.
findings.fix: Freeze the list in A07 now, word for word as A23 line 96 has it. CHAIN_ID must be in {31337, 84532}. For 31337 the host is exactly localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1 or chain. For 84532 the host is exactly sepolia.base.org, with no other host until A86's A07.1 loop adds named provider hosts; the network must be baseSepolia and TESTNET_OPT_IN=A86 must be set. Matching is exact, never by suffix. mainnet.base.org is refused under every chain id. Replace '*.base.org' everywhere in the note. Add guard tests for: mainnet.base.org with 84532 and the opt-in (CHAIN_RPC_NOT_LOCAL), sepolia.base.org without the opt-in (refused) and api.sepolia.base.org (refused). State that A23's static test is the equality check between A07 and A08, not a copy step inside either node.

findings.issue: The contracts workspace and the vendored code will fail A01's repo-wide verify steps, and A07 cannot change the A01-owned configs that would fix it. (1) A01 runs 'eslint .' and 'prettier --check .' with no vendor exclusion. ESLint flat config does not read .gitignore, and dot-folders are not ignored by default. So upstream TypeScript and JavaScript in contracts/vendor/T-REX and contracts/.vendor-work/T-REX get linted with type-checked rules and format-checked, and fail. The same goes for infra/chain/entrypoint.ts and healthcheck.ts, which sit in no tsconfig project. (2) A01's config lint requires every workspace 'test' script to invoke vitest, but A07's contracts 'test' runs Hardhat (mocha) tests. (3) A01's base tsconfig (NodeNext, verbatimModuleSyntax, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noUncheckedIndexedAccess) allows only the Next.js module override. Hardhat 2 loads a CommonJS TypeScript config through ts-node, and ESM import syntax in a CommonJS file is an error under verbatimModuleSyntax. (4) smoke.ts imports upstream's TypeScript fixture, so tsc typechecks upstream code under strict flags. (5) Scripts print to the console, and A01 has no-console outside scripts/. The spec is silent on all five, so pass criterion 1 fails, or the builder edits A01's files and breaks the owned-path check.
findings.fix: Add a 'Conformance with A01 verify' subsection and the matching A01 amendment (an A01.x loop, or a named registration hook). eslint and prettier ignore contracts/vendor/** and the working copy, through an ignore entry A07 owns and A01's config reads. Better still, move the working copy out of the contracts workspace to a gitignored repo-root folder (for example .cache/vendor-work/T-REX/) that no tsconfig, eslint glob or Hardhat sources root can sweep up. The contracts 'test' script runs vitest for the host-side toolchain tests. Hardhat and mocha tests are registered as a separate verify step ('test:hardhat'). Fix the contracts tsconfig settings the chosen Hardhat line needs, as a named exception A01's config lint allows. smoke.ts loads upstream's fixture at runtime without typechecking it (a dynamic import of a computed path, with an A07-owned .d.ts). Move entrypoint.ts and healthcheck.ts into packages/chain-control (for example src/container/). Allow console output in contracts/scripts/** through the same exception. Add a pass criterion: a fresh clone with setup:chain run passes lint, format, typecheck and the vitest config lint.

findings.issue: The owned paths are still inconsistent, and one edit needed by the build has no permission. final-graph.json still gives A07 only 'contracts root files (hardhat.config.ts, package.json, LICENSE notes)', vendor/, packages/contracts root files and infra/chain/. It lacks contracts/toolchain/, contracts/scripts/toolchain/, contracts/test/toolchain/, contracts/aa/, the contracts tsconfig, .gitignore and TOOLCHAIN.md, packages/chain-control/, .gitmodules and the secrets-allowlist exception. A01's check-owned-paths reads the list from the vault graph, so standing criterion 3 fails on A07's own files. The note also tells the builder to name install-script packages in A01's scripts\toolchain.json, which A07 does not own and has no exception for. Hardhat pulls in keccak, secp256k1 and similar packages with install scripts, so A01's verify step 2 requires that edit.
findings.fix: Update final-graph.json (and the generated app-graph.json) to the note's list, and add two append-only exceptions: scripts\secrets-allowlist.json (mnemonic and deterministic-account entries only) and scripts\toolchain.json (installScripts entries for packages from contracts/package.json only). Have A01's check-owned-paths tolerate them, or have A01 read per-workspace fragment files. Add a Fable probe that diffs both files and finds only the permitted entries.

findings.issue: The claim 'contracts/typechain-types/ is gitignored by A01' is false. A01's .gitignore lists only contracts/artifacts and contracts/cache. On a fresh clone the first compile inside verify creates typechain-types/, so A01's step 12 check (git status unchanged by verify, untracked files included) fails.
findings.fix: List contracts/typechain-types/ (plus artifacts/ and cache/) in A07's own contracts/.gitignore, or register them through the realx 'gitignore' block. Correct the Owned paths sentence. Extend pass criterion 1: git status --untracked-files=all is identical before and after verify on a fresh clone.

findings.issue: The deployment-output interface still disagrees with its consumers. A07 says A24, A25 and A26 write only to contracts/deployments-local/<chainId>/ and A27 reads it. A25 (R6) writes contracts/deploy/gateway/out/<chainId>/gateway.json and tells A27 to import that. A27 (lines 47 and 118) says A24, A25 and A26 call its writeManifest() and contracts:export from their deploy scripts. That is three incompatible mechanisms. A23 (line 86), A26 (line 152) and A27 (line 39) also still cite 'A07's control.ts' or 'infra/chain/control.ts', which no longer exists (it is now @realx/chain-control).
findings.fix: Choose one contract in A07 and name it the frozen interface. Deploy scripts write fragments only to contracts/deployments-local/<chainId>/<suite>.json (schema in TOOLCHAIN.md). A27's exporter reads them and alone writes packages/contracts/deployments/ and src/abis. Record follow-up edits for A25, A27, A23 and A26 (control.ts becomes @realx/chain-control). Name A23 as a consumer of @realx/chain-control alongside A27.

findings.issue: The GPL-3.0 inheritance list is inside A07's owned path, yet later nodes must write to it. It lives in contracts/vendor/LICENSE-NOTES.md, which A07 owns, but A24, A25 and A26 must append their files, so their owned-path checks fail. A24 (line 163) cites 'A07's registration convention' for that edit, but A07 defines no such convention. The same A24 line still says it 'replaces A07's no .sol outside vendor check', which contradicts A07's final-form check.
findings.fix: Have the licence check discover per-owner inheritance files, for example contracts/src/<area>/LICENSE-INHERITANCE.json, each under its owning node's path. LICENSE-NOTES.md then states the rule and never needs editing. Make the check fail on any GPL-3.0 SPDX file outside vendor that is not listed in some inheritance file. Record the follow-up edit in A24.

findings.issue: There is no chain-start date control, which A27 requires of A07. A27 (lines 40 and 148) needs the Docker chain to start with Hardhat initialDate set from CHAIN_GENESIS_DATE, because chain time cannot move backwards and must align with A06's AS_OF platform clock. It lists this as an A07 configuration item, but A07 never mentions it. Hardhat's default genesis time is wall-clock, so block timestamps differ between boots.
findings.fix: Add an optional CHAIN_GENESIS_DATE (ISO 8601 UTC) that the guard validates and passes to hardhat node and to the in-process hardhat network as initialDate, with a fixed documented default in TOOLCHAIN.md (not wall-clock). Add a pass criterion: the genesis block timestamp equals the configured date on two boots and after a restart. Name A06 or A23 as the setter in compose.

findings.issue: Parallel-node worktrees will not have the submodule. A01's worktree policy (git worktree add, then npm ci, then verify) does not initialise submodules, so from A07 onward every later node's verify fails at once with VENDOR_NOT_INITIALISED. The same happens to any fresh-clone standing check made without --recurse-submodules. Neither A07 nor A01 states the orchestrator step.
findings.fix: State in A07 (and request an A01 or App Gauntlet amendment) that from A07's commit on, every worktree and fresh clone runs 'git submodule update --init --recursive' and, for chain nodes, 'npm run setup:chain' before verify. State whether verify itself needs setup:chain (it should need only the initialised submodule). Add a Fable probe: a new worktree plus the documented steps gives a green verify.

findings.issue: The OpenZeppelin 4 pin can clash with A25. A07 pins @openzeppelin/contracts and contracts-upgradeable to exactly what T-REX's lockfile resolves, and one version per package name serves every 0.8.17 source. A25 (line 42) independently pins OpenZeppelin to '4.9.x'. If the pinned tag's lockfile resolves 4.8.x, the two nodes contradict each other and A25 cannot get its version without breaking A07's pin check and the T-REX bytecode equality.
findings.fix: State in A07 that the single OpenZeppelin 4 version for all 0.8.17 RealX code is the one recorded in MANIFEST.json and TOOLCHAIN.md, and that downstream nodes must not pin their own. Record a follow-up for A25 to read the version from TOOLCHAIN.md instead of '4.9.x', and to check that the OZ APIs it names exist in that version.

findings.issue: The guard's 'selected network' rules cannot be evaluated where the spec puts them. In Hardhat 2 the config file runs before --network is resolved into hre, so 'only when the selected network is baseSepolia' and the DEFAULT_KEY_NOT_LOCAL rule need a mechanism the spec does not name. Parsing argv misses HARDHAT_NETWORK and programmatic runs. accounts.json is described as listing addresses, yet the guard is said to detect 'any accounts.json key'.
findings.fix: State that network-dependent rules run in an extendEnvironment or task-override hook against hre.network.name and hre.network.config, and that the config-time pass covers only the environment-variable rules. Test both HARDHAT_NETWORK=baseSepolia and --network. Say whether accounts.json holds only addresses (the guard then derives the keys from the default mnemonic) or also the public keys.
